purpose: Bounded product truth and copy direction for preparing ServSync internal marketing drafts without inventing capabilities, results, or competitor problems.
positioningConcepts: Start with a recognizable customer or contractor problem, then explain one concrete way ServSync can help.
Keep customer service work organized from request through estimate, job, report, invoice, Home History, and follow-up without making every piece summarize the entire sequence.
Help small service contractors present clear customer experiences without claiming enterprise automation.
Help homeowners keep service requests, decisions, documents, and completed work connected to the right home.

terminology.rule: Use the current homeowner-facing product name.
Use normal sentence capitalization in public copy. Use homeowner only when specifically discussing a homeowner account or homeowner experience.

terminology.avoid: Not connected Customer or eligible customer
terminology.rule: Use plain public language for document-scoped interactions that do not require a registered account. Keep internal status and authorization terminology out of public copy.
Estimate acceptance through a secure delivery session is not verified identity or a signature.
Production Stripe payments and Pay Online are not active.
Do not capitalize internal ServSync object names in public copy unless normal grammar requires it.

guestAndConnectedHomeownerTruth.plainLanguageSummary: ServSync supports both immediate document-specific customer interactions and an optional longer-term connected homeowner relationship.

withoutRegisteredAccount.claim: For eligible work, a customer can use a secure, expiring link to review an estimate, respond to that exact estimate version, view an invoice, or view a finalized customer-facing report without first creating a ServSync account.
withoutRegisteredAccount.boundaries: This is document-scoped access, not a broad guest portal, verified identity, unrestricted property history, or a claim that another product forces account creation or app downloads.

connectedHomeowner.claim: A homeowner may create a ServSync account and connect with a contractor to use ongoing authenticated experiences such as service requests, estimate and invoice review, property-linked records, Documents, Home History, and manual reminders where currently supported.
connectedHomeowner.boundaries: Do not imply automatic sharing of all home information, universal notification delivery, unlimited storage, or access outside the homeowner's choices and current product permissions.

relationshipValue.claim: The connected path can help both parties keep future service activity and eligible records organized around an ongoing homeowner-contractor relationship.
relationshipValue.boundaries: Describe this as an available choice and product benefit, not a requirement, guarantee, measured outcome, or reason to disparage the document-specific path.

prefer: specific hooks and short readable sentences
one concrete ServSync capability or benefit
copyQualityGuidance.rule: These are contextual writing cautions, not a banned-word list. Use product terminology only when it helps a normal reader.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Customers can start service work with a request tied to the relevant home and contractor workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not promise emergency dispatch, guaranteed response, automated matching, or full external messaging.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can prepare, send, and track estimates tied to customer and work context.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Secure guest acceptance and bounded responses are not electronic signatures, negotiation, or payment.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can keep reusable Service, Labor, Material, and Fee items in a private Price Book, start manually or from an editable blank-price generic starter, import or export CSV/XLSX catalogs, and copy selected items into estimate drafts.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim market pricing, trade-specific or provider catalogs, automatic pricing, inventory, assemblies, direct invoice selection, accounting sync, scheduled sync, universal spreadsheet compatibility, or private cost and margin export.

marketableCapabilities.claim: For eligible work, customers can receive a secure, expiring estimate link and respond to that exact delivered version without first creating a ServSync account.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim verified identity, signatures, guaranteed inbox delivery, SMS, replies, a broad guest portal, or that competitors require accounts or app downloads.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can keep jobs and finalized customer-facing work reports connected to the originating service workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim code compliance, third-party certification, enterprise dispatch, or automated diagnostics.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Eligible finalized customer-facing reports can be delivered through a secure document-scoped link to a customer without a ServSync account.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim report acknowledgment, unrestricted document browsing, access to private/internal content, or competitor account requirements.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can create, review, send, and track invoices in the same customer service workflow.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not claim accounting synchronization, automatic collections, or live online payment processing.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Accepted estimates can produce a deliberate draft deposit invoice, and authorized contractors can record manual or offline partial and full payments.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Job creation is not blocked by deposit state. Do not claim refunds, chargebacks, payouts, or Pay Online.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Homeowners can keep eligible completed work, reports, invoice records, documents, and manual reminders organized around their home.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not promise automatic timeline intelligence, recurring reminders, email, SMS, push alerts, or unlimited storage.

marketableCapabilities.claim: Contractors can maintain a recognizable business profile with supported business and service information.
marketableCapabilities.boundaries: Do not imply license, insurance, background-check, or credential verification unless separately verified.

unavailableOrRestrictedCapabilities: Production online payments or Pay Online
Automated email campaigns, SMS, or cold outreach
AI-generated recommendations, diagnostics, or autonomous approval
Guaranteed leads, marketplace ranking, or contractor performance claims
Public Trade Pack or professional HVAC content
Accounting, calendar, advertising, or CRM integrations unless later documented as active

competitiveFramingPolicy.rule: Describe ServSync on its own merits. Do not manufacture a competitor problem to make ServSync look better.
requiresVerifiedEvidenceAndApproval: competitors require homeowners to create accounts
competitors require app downloads or subscriptions
competitors make customers perform unnecessary steps
competitors are more difficult, expensive, fragmented, or inferior
preferredApproach: explain how the current ServSync experience works
describe why that choice can be useful
describe guest and connected-homeowner paths without treating either as a burden

categories: Invented customer, contractor, homeowner, signup, revenue, or usage counts
Invented savings, conversion, growth, performance, or time-reduction metrics
Testimonials, ratings, awards, rankings, guarantees, or unverified trust claims
Unsupported integrations, competitive comparisons, competitor requirements, or unavailable functionality
Legal, licensing, certification, safety, or identity-assurance claims not established by the product
prohibitedPatterns: unsupported competitor requirements or superiority claims
